newsitem.title: USA: Chapman, Nuveen retained by Illinois authority.
newsitem.headline: Chapman, Nuveen retained by Illinois authority.

text.p: Illinois Educational Facilities Authority on Thursday retained Chapman and Cutler as bond counsel and John Nuveen & Co Inc as financial adviser for the next year.
Thomas Conley, the authority's director, said the board was "very satisfied" with the services provided by the two firms.
Chapman has served the authority as bond counsel since 1970 and Nuveen has been its financial adviser for the past two years, according to Conley.

In April, the Illinois Health Facilities Authority ended its long-time bond counsel relationship with Chapman when it chose Jones Day, Reavis & Pogue, which had hired four Chapman partners and two associates in January.
